source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 11 (2024), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.249
closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Exact Theorem1 statement167–175 and complete two-step primary proof365–501 are preserved, including the non-Galois case and the zero-point reference. All necessary E-function, house and differential-system conventions and the source's Galois-compatible zero criterion/desingularization context are retained. Shidlovskii's rational quantitative bound, Beukers desingularization and normal-basis theory are explicit prior foundations. The new rational descent and closed differential-system construction needed to apply that bound are present, not replaced by an assumed general-number-field bound. The stronger integer-only alternative and later qualitative applications are unselected.
current_difficulty_reason: Shidlovskii's quoted quantitative theorem applies to rational-coefficient E-functions and cannot simply be applied to the given number-field vector or a possibly singular evaluation point. The authors remove singularities and dependencies, then construct a Galois product whose normal-basis rational components form a closed rational differential system and whose evaluated combination has integer coefficients. Tracking the nonzero product, coefficient houses and non-Galois coset action completes a source-specific descent construction beyond merely applying a field norm inequality.
